name: salesforce-account-engagement
notes: Deploy this MCP with MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http behind HTTPS.
Do not expose Salesforce client secrets in ChatGPT connector headers.
Authenticate the MCP host to Salesforce using server-side refresh tokens.
ChatGPT developer mode / custom connectors require a reachable HTTPS MCP endpoint.
Keep AE_READ_ONLY=true unless write access is explicitly required.
